title: Recipe browsing
question: Does compact inspection keep results and actions readable while full reference stays easy to reach?
task: Find a recipe, inspect its ingredient, return, cook once, then inspect the recorded result.
surface: Cooking service, local inspection, expanded reference; You, inventory and Reports stay visible.
fixture: Synthetic stock, access and scripted success. Pinned YAIR recipe definitions, tokens and detail renderer from the retained recipe experiment. No game save access.
limits: Simplified five-region frame, two recipes, no native RNG/XP or production navigation. Visual choice and native integration remain open.
